description.value: Dakota Café is a cozy breakfast-and-lunch spot tucked inside the Victoria Flying Club building at the base of the Victoria International Airport tower, giving diners a front-row view of aircraft movements from the patio. The café is known for house-made wonton soup, fresh cinnamon buns, and locally sourced seasonal ingredients. Its rustic, window-seat atmosphere and friendly staff make it a welcoming stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

address.value: 101-1852 Canso Road, North Saanich, Victoria BC V8L 5V5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides consistent contact details (phone, address, email) across multiple pages. OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes; the website about page explicitly lists 'VEGAN FRIENDLY' as a feature alongside local ingredients. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Sidney' but the website address is 101-1852 Canso Road, North Saanich — the business is at the Victoria Flying Club near YYJ airport, not in Sidney proper. The OSM node may be misassigned to the Sidney community boundary.
OSM record has no address or phone fields populated; contact details sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active café with a confirmed web presence and consistent contact details; its location near Victoria International Airport on the Saanich Peninsula makes it a useful refueling stop for touring cyclists on the peninsula loop.
